name: flow
description: The orca-flow pattern in one Claude Code session: a super manager starts managers, managers start workers in their own git worktrees, a merge queue merges and deploys; a Flow pane shows the tree

test_command.title: Test command
test_command.description: What a worker runs to check its package, e.g. npm test. Empty: the tests covering the changed files.

full_check_command.title: Full check
full_check_command.description: What the merge queue runs once per batch before pushing, e.g. npm run check. Empty: no full check (the queue says so).

deploy_command.title: Deploy command
deploy_command.description: What the merge queue runs after pushing. Empty: no deploy.

merge_method.title: Merge method without a queue
merge_method.description: gh pr merge method managers use when the merge queue is off.

merge_queue.title: Merge queue
merge_queue.description: On: managers hand PRs to one merge queue. Off: managers merge themselves.

max_managers.title: Managers at once
max_managers.description: How many managers the main session runs at a time.

max_workers.title: Workers per manager
max_workers.description: How many workers one manager runs at a time.

test_slots.title: Test slots
test_slots.description: How many heavy test runs (a whole suite, the full check) may run at once across all agents of the session. Minimum 1.

context_warn_percent.title: Context warning
context_warn_percent.description: The Flow pane marks this percent of the context window on each agent's meter, and the meter turns yellow at or past it (1 to 100).

context_warn_tokens.title: Context limit in tokens
context_warn_tokens.description: Hand off at this many tokens, or at the percent of the window above when that is lower (0 = percent only). Also places the meter marker.

handoff.title: Handoff
handoff.description: On: a worker or manager that reaches the context warning percent is told to commit, push and write a handoff note, and its parent continues on a fresh agent. Off: the meter only shows.

main_checkout_guard.title: Main-checkout guard
main_checkout_guard.description: On: Edit, Write and obvious shell writes (redirects, sed -i, git commit and friends) aimed at the repo's main checkout are refused, for every flow agent and the main session. Worktrees and .git/ stay writable.

main_checkout_allow.title: Main checkout: still writable
main_checkout_allow.description: Comma-separated paths relative to the repo root that stay writable in the main checkout; one ending in / covers a directory.

max_continues.title: Max continues
max_continues.description: After a branch has handed off this many times, the owning manager is told the package is too big and should be split. It only warns.

manager_model.title: Manager model
manager_model.description: Model alias for managers. Set explicitly so it does not follow the main session's model.

queue_model.title: Merge queue model
queue_model.description: Model alias for the merge queue. Set explicitly so it does not follow the main session's model.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language agents write PRs, briefs and reports in.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.description: auto: after each PR the queue merges, and when the queue ends, remove worktrees and local branches of finished work that are clean and on the base or in a merged PR. off: only /flow clean. Uncommitted, unpushed, locked and live work is never removed.

worker_harness.title: Worker harness
worker_harness.description: What managers start workers with: agent (a flow:worker in this session), or a harness run in a terminal: claude, codex, gemini, opencode, or a name from the harnesses setting. Managers can still pick another one per worker.

session_host.title: Session host
session_host.description: Where workers in other harnesses run: auto (Orca when it is running, else tmux), orca or tmux.

harnesses.title: Harnesses
harnesses.description: JSON object of harness name to a start command line, or to {start, resume?, program?, quota?}, over the built-ins, e.g. {"aider": {"start": "aider --yes-always --message-file {prompt_file}", "resume": "aider --restore-chat-history"}}. {prompt} is the prompt as one shell word, {prompt_file} its path; quota is a shell command printing a percent left; "" removes a built-in.

min_quota.title: Minimum harness quota
min_quota.description: A session worker whose harness reports its quota (codex built in, or a harness with a quota command) is refused, and the manager starts an agent worker instead, when less than this percent is left. 0: never refused.

base_branch.title: Base branch
base_branch.description: Branch PRs target and the queue pushes to. Empty: the remote's default branch.
